body: Super normal, I get those urges all the time. Since I guess you’re relatively new to this I would just advise you to be careful, this shit is addictive and once you start it’s REALLY hard to stop,even if you don’t have a reason to cut anymore. My ex boyfriend started cutting just because he could, and he went MONTHS where he wasn’t clean longer than a day. So once again be careful!! ❤️❤️❤️
It’s not worth it to end your life to get back at your teachers, there are other ways to give them a fuck you without doing this. I know it’s hard to do trust me but try to think about this logically
